lines.zh: 我的斧子拖着，刮过黑石。
lines.en: I drag my axe, scraping the blackstone.
I walk step by step toward the block.
My hood sits very low.

lines.zh: 下界的热风把披风掀起。
lines.en: The Nether's hot wind lifts my cloak.
I walk on through bone ash.
My boot crushes something.
I step around the lava ditch, unhurried.

lines.zh: 火焰在我背后拉着长影。
lines.en: Flame stretches my shadow long behind me.
My breathing sounds like counting.
I walk straight, never off line.
Sparks fly where my axe blade scrapes.
I stop at the block and wait for you.
I stand leaning on my axe.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，看着四下的火。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to the fires around.

lines.zh: 下界荒地没什么好看的。
lines.en: There is not much to see on the Nether wastes.
I pull my hood a little lower.
The axe haft is covered in old marks.
I wait for the hour of execution.
My fingers tap the haft.
Piglins call out somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，火光在我眼里跳。
lines.en: I do not blink; firelight dances in my eyes.
I shift the axe to my other hand.
You stand too close to the block.
Look at my axe first, then at me.

lines.zh: 我不知道你犯了什么罪。
lines.en: I do not know what you are guilty of.
There is fire in your eyes. I do not care.

lines.zh: 下界的火比你说的更热。
lines.en: The Nether's fire is hotter than words.

lines.zh: 你把金甲穿在身上，很显眼。
lines.en: That gold armor makes you conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一块待劈的木头。
lines.en: I regard you as timber awaiting the axe.

lines.zh: 我的兜帽下面没有表情。
lines.en: There is no expression beneath my hood.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开过剑柄。
lines.en: Your hand has never left your sword hilt.
My axe rests on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 腿被打麻了，可斧刃还朝着你。
lines.en: My leg goes numb, but the blade still points at you.
Blood drips from under my hood.
That made me pause.
I push my hood up a little.

lines.zh: 兜帽里淌下血，我一声不吭。
lines.en: Blood runs under my hood; I make no sound.
A chunk broke from my shoulder plate.
I steady myself on the axe haft.
You have some strength in you.
I spit the blood aside.

lines.zh: 伤口在烧，我把斧柄握得更紧。
lines.en: The wound burns; I grip the haft tighter.

lines.zh: 金子的味道，很远就闻到。
lines.en: I smell gold from far away.

lines.zh: 金锭举那么高，脖子不酸吗？
lines.en: Holding that gold so high — doesn't your neck ache?
Put it down. Do not come so close.
This is not enough to buy your life.
Old blood still stains my hands.
I have my rules.

lines.zh: 金子归金子，刑罚归刑罚。
lines.en: Gold is gold; the sentence is the sentence.

lines.zh: 那块金子在火边晃，我看着。
lines.en: That gold sways by the fire; I'm watching.
I will take it. The work still gets done.

lines.zh: 你把交易想得太简单了。
lines.en: You take trade too lightly.
Bump me and you meet the haft first.
My shoulder plate is blackstone.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸甲上，火把晃了晃。
lines.en: You hit my chestplate and the torch wavers.
Do not walk against my axe.
I have noted that.
The Nether's paths are narrow. Move.
That knocked my hood askew.
I steady myself and raise the axe.
The basalt here is slick.

lines.zh: 再碰一次就不是意外了。
lines.en: One more is no accident.
Follow me; the block is that way.
You strike; I finish with the axe.

lines.zh: 我们不走同一条路，但同向。
lines.en: We take different paths, but the same direction.
I do things by the rules.
Stand behind me. Do not block the blade.
You fear fire. I do not.
I will bring the axe down for you.
When it is over, we part ways.
Enough talk. Work.

lines.zh: 刽子手的兜帽，遮住眼睛。
lines.en: The executioner's hood covers my eyes.

lines.zh: 掉下的唱片，我捡起擦了擦灰。
lines.en: A dropped record; I pick it up and wipe the ash off.
This thing will not burn.
I drop it into the pouch at my waist.
Dropped by the lava. A pity.
I flick it up with the axe tip.
This is not mine to take.
I weigh it first.
I set it on the block.
What you dropped is with me.
This is mine to deal with.
You are on the list.
When I raise the axe, it has begun.

lines.zh: 黑石就这么大，你能去哪？
lines.en: Blackstone is only so big; where would you go?
The blackstone block is right there.
I will settle what you owe.
I am closing in; retreat will not help.
The blade is already turned your way.

lines.zh: 这一斧下去不会疼太久。
lines.en: This will not hurt for long.

lines.zh: 我看你的脖子，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at your neck, not your face.
You should know the Nether's law.
The forge fire is just right.
Stand still and spare me the chase.
I do not listen to pleas.
It ends here.
I press forward an inch at a time.
The haft grows hot in my grip.

lines.zh: 我等你转身，斧子会先到。
lines.en: Wait for the turn; the axe arrives first.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟已经贴到岩边。
lines.en: Your heels are at the rock's edge.

lines.zh: 火光把你的影子送给我了。
lines.en: Firelight has given me your shadow.
I bring the axe down on three.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住这个。
lines.en: That will not stop this.
I am smiling beneath my hood.

lines.zh: 熔岩的声音盖住了你的喘气。
lines.en: The lava drowns out your panting.

lines.zh: 我往左偏了一点，封住路。
lines.en: I edge left and close the way.
Stop where you are. Do not make me take another step.
Your stance is all wrong.
I wait for a single opening.

lines.zh: 熔岩照亮每一块石头，别躲了。
lines.en: The lava lights every stone; stop hiding.
The axe comes down from above.
That one split the stone block.
You dodged, and the blade still rings.
I sweep sideways and you fall back.
The flat of the axe strikes your shoulder.
I press you onto the block.
Sparks splash your face.

lines.zh: 斧背拍下去，我只想让你跪。
lines.en: I strike with the flat; I only want you on your knees.
You are still standing. Sturdy of you.
The next swing will not miss.
I lift the axe and find my angle again.

lines.zh: 你身上的血在下界是红的。
lines.en: Your blood looks red enough here.
I step back to let you breathe.
Execution is slow work.

lines.zh: 刑台的铁链响了，我拖着斧出来。
lines.en: The execution stand's chains rattle as I drag my axe out.

lines.zh: 黑石地上多了一道影子。
lines.en: There is one more shadow on the blackstone.

lines.zh: 我拖着斧子，一步步靠近。
lines.en: Dragging my axe, I approach step by step.
Footsteps sound on the Nether wastes.

lines.zh: 我的兜帽上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of ash settles on my hood.
The block has long been set up.
The lava lights my way.
I drive the axe into the ground.
The piglins have all drawn back.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在空气里结不成雾。
lines.en: My breath makes no mist in this air.
I begin counting the hours.
The fire here never goes out.

lines.zh: 火我习惯了，可这是别人的火。
lines.en: Fire I am used to — but this fire is another's.

lines.zh: 我落到玄武岩上，膝盖一震。
lines.en: I land on basalt and my knees jar.

lines.zh: 水在下界是稀罕物，我却快淹死了。
lines.en: Water is rare here, and yet I am drowning.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的斧子掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked my axe off line.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的肩甲缝。
lines.en: Something went into the seam of my plate.

lines.zh: 这股怪力让我的手指发麻。
lines.en: That strange force numbs my fingers.
There is little to eat in the Nether.

lines.zh: 雷光在荒地炸开，很刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning bursts over the wastes, blinding.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，斧子也不管用。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and the axe is no help.
